result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but a few minor visual issues were found: a truncated restaurant name, horizontally cut-off content cards in the carousel, and a partially cut-off card at the bottom edge.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with an ellipsis in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, and the card itself is cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards are fully visible or adjust card widths/padding so names are readable; consider full name truncation with proper accessibility labels.

issues.description: The last restaurant card (pizza image with -20% badge) is cut off mid-card at the bottom of the visible area without any indication of more content.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card is fully rendered or provide partial-card affordance (e.g., peek of next card) to hint the list is scrollable.

issues.description: Category filter chips (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, etc.) are cut off at the right edge with no visible scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade or scroll affordance to indicate horizontally scrollable filter chips.
